### 해외 주식 직접투자 기반 인출 전략 시뮬레이터

해외 주식 직투 계좌에서 매년 일정 비율을 인출하여 생활비로 사용할 때, 양도소득세(22% 및 기본공제 250만 원)와 물가상승률이 자산 수명에 미치는 영향을 역산하는 계산기입니다. 하단의 제어판에서 조건을 변경하면 그래프와 포트폴리오 변동 내역 현황판이 실시간으로 동기화됩니다.

```{=html}
<div class="simulator-control-panel" style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 18px; padding: 1.5rem; margin: 2rem 0; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif;">
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem;">
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">총 자산 (억 원)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputTotalAsset" value="10" step="0.5" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">현재 누적 수익률 (%)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputCurrentReturn" value="100" step="5" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">예상(기대) 수익률 (%)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputExpectedReturn" value="8" step="0.5" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">연간 인출률 (%)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputWithdrawalRate" value="4" step="0.5" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">물가상승률 (0~10%)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputInflationRate" value="2.5" min="0" max="10" step="0.1" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">시뮬레이션 기간</label>
      <select id="selectPeriod" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px; background:white;">
        <option value="5">5년</option>
        <option value="10" selected>10년</option>
        <option value="20">20년</option>
        <option value="30">30년</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
  <button id="btnCalculate" style="width:100%; background:#007aff; color:white; border:none; padding:10px; border-radius:10px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;">시뮬레이션 엔진 가동</button>
</div>

<div class="chart-container-wrapper" style="display: block; width: 100%; clear: both; margin: 2rem 0;">
  <div id="simulationChart" style="width: 100%; max-width: 850px; height: 450px; margin: 0 auto;"></div>
</div>

<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 2rem auto; max-width: 850px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif;">
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">1년차 현금흐름 (세후/실질)</span>
    <span id="kpiYear1CashFlow" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: #007aff;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">년 평균 실질 현금흐름 변동률</span>
    <span id="kpiCashFlowChange" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">1년차 자산 가치 (실질)</span>
    <span id="kpiYear1Asset" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: #34c759;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">년 평균 자산 실질 가치 변동률</span>
    <span id="kpiAssetChange" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
</div>

<details style="margin: 2.5rem auto; max-width: 850px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif;">
  <summary style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f; padding: 12px 16px; background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 10px; list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; user-select: none; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span>📋 연차별 정밀 정산 내역 디스플레이</span>
    <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 400;">클릭하여 펼치기 ▾</span>
  </summary>
  <div style="overflow-x: auto; margin-top: 1rem; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e8e8ed;">
    <table class="table" style="width: 100%; min-width: 650px; font-size: 0.88rem; text-align: center; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="background: #fafafa; border-bottom: 2px solid #1d1d1f; font-weight: 600;">
          <th style="padding: 12px 4px; width: 15%;">연차</th>
          <th style="padding: 12px 4px; width: 45%;">현금흐름 (세전 / 세금 / 세후)</th>
          <th style="padding: 12px 4px; width: 40%;">잔액 (물가 반영 전 / 실질 가치)</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="simulationTableBody">
        </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</details>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const btnCalculate = document.getElementById('btnCalculate');
    
    function runSimulation() {
      if (typeof Plotly === 'undefined') { setTimeout(runSimulation, 200); return; }

      let initialAsset = (parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputTotalAsset').value) || 0) * 100000000;
      let currentReturn = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputCurrentReturn').value) || 0;
      let expectedReturn = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputExpectedReturn').value) || 0;
      let withdrawalRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputWithdrawalRate').value) || 0;
      let inflationRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputInflationRate').value) || 0;
      let period = parseInt(document.getElementById('selectPeriod').value) || 30;

      let assetNominal = initialAsset;
      let currentR = currentReturn;

      let principal = assetNominal / (1 + (currentR / 100));
      let gains = assetNominal - principal;

      let xYears = [];
      let yNominal = [];
      let yReal = [];
      let tableHtml = "";

      let sumCashFlowChange = 0;
      let countCashFlowChange = 0;
      let prevNetCashFlowReal = null;

      let sumAssetChange = 0;
      let prevRealAssetValue = initialAsset;

      let year1CashFlowReal = 0;
      let year1AssetReal = 0;

      for (let i = 1; i <= period; i++) {
        if (assetNominal <= 0) {
          tableHtml += `<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed; color:#ff3b30;"><td style="padding:12px 4px;">${i}년차</td><td colspan="2">자산 고갈 (시스템 정지)</td></tr>`;
          xYears.push(`${i}년`);
          yNominal.push(0);
          yReal.push(0);
          continue;
        }

        let withdrawalNominal = assetNominal * (withdrawalRate / 100);
        if (withdrawalNominal > assetNominal) withdrawalNominal = assetNominal;

        let gainInWithdrawal = withdrawalNominal * (currentR / (100 + currentR));

        let tax = 0;
        if (gainInWithdrawal > 2500000) {
          tax = (gainInWithdrawal - 2500000) * 0.22;
        }
        let netCashFlow = withdrawalNominal - tax;

        let inflationFactor = Math.pow(1 + (inflationRate / 100), i);
        let netCashFlowReal = netCashFlow / inflationFactor;

        if (i === 1) {
          year1CashFlowReal = netCashFlowReal;
        }

        if (prevNetCashFlowReal !== null && prevNetCashFlowReal > 0) {
          let cfChange = ((netCashFlowReal - prevNetCashFlowReal) / prevNetCashFlowReal) * 100;
          sumCashFlowChange += cfChange;
          countCashFlowChange++;
        }
        prevNetCashFlowReal = netCashFlowReal;

        let assetRemaining = assetNominal - withdrawalNominal;
        let pRatio = assetNominal > 0 ? (assetRemaining / assetNominal) : 0;
        principal = principal * pRatio;
        gains = gains * pRatio;

        let growth = assetRemaining * (expectedReturn / 100);
        let nominalBeforeInflation = assetRemaining + growth;

        gains = gains + growth;
        currentR = principal > 0 ? ((gains / principal) * 100) : 0;
        let realAssetValue = nominalBeforeInflation / inflationFactor;

        if (i === 1) {
          year1AssetReal = realAssetValue;
        }

        if (prevRealAssetValue > 0) {
          let assetChange = ((realAssetValue - prevRealAssetValue) / prevRealAssetValue) * 100;
          sumAssetChange += assetChange;
        }
        prevRealAssetValue = realAssetValue;

        xYears.push(`${i}년`);
        yNominal.push(Math.round(nominalBeforeInflation / 1000000) / 100);
        yReal.push(Math.round(realAssetValue / 1000000) / 100);

        tableHtml += `
          <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed;">
            <td style="padding: 12px 4px; font-weight:500;">${i}년차</td>
            <td style="padding: 12px 4px; text-align:left; padding-left:5%;">
              <span style="color:#86868b;">세전:</span> ₩${Math.round(withdrawalNominal).toLocaleString()}<br>
              <span style="color:#ff2d55;">세금:</span> ₩${Math.round(tax).toLocaleString()}<br>
              <span style="color:#86868b;">세후(명목):</span> ₩${Math.round(netCashFlow).toLocaleString()}<br>
              <span style="color:#007aff; font-weight:600;">세후(실질):</span> ₩${Math.round(netCashFlowReal).toLocaleString()}
            </td>
            <td style="padding: 12px 4px; text-align:left; padding-left:5%; font-family:monospace;">
              <span style="color:#86868b;">반영 전:</span> ₩${Math.round(nominalBeforeInflation).toLocaleString()}<br>
              <span style="color:#34c759; font-weight:600;">실질:</span> ₩${Math.round(realAssetValue).toLocaleString()}
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;

        assetNominal = nominalBeforeInflation;
      }

      document.getElementById('simulationTableBody').innerHTML = tableHtml;

      document.getElementById('kpiYear1CashFlow').innerText = '₩' + Math.round(year1CashFlowReal).toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById('kpiYear1Asset').innerText = '₩' + Math.round(year1AssetReal).toLocaleString();

      let avgCashFlowChange = countCashFlowChange > 0 ? (sumCashFlowChange / countCashFlowChange) : 0;
      let avgAssetChange = period > 0 ? (sumAssetChange / period) : 0;

      const kpiCF = document.getElementById('kpiCashFlowChange');
      kpiCF.innerText = (avgCashFlowChange >= 0 ? '+' : '') + avgCashFlowChange.toFixed(2) + '%';
      kpiCF.style.color = avgCashFlowChange >= 0 ? '#007aff' : '#ff2d55';

      const kpiAs = document.getElementById('kpiAssetChange');
      kpiAs.innerText = (avgAssetChange >= 0 ? '+' : '') + avgAssetChange.toFixed(2) + '%';
      kpiAs.style.color = avgAssetChange >= 0 ? '#34c759' : '#ff2d55';

      let traceNominal = {
        x: xYears, y: yNominal, name: '자산 가치 (물가 미반영)', type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines+markers',
        line: { color: '#8e8e93', width: 2 }, marker: { size: 4 },
        hovertemplate: '<b>%{x}</b><br>물가 미반영: %{y}억 원<br><extra></extra>'
      };
      let traceReal = {
        x: xYears, y: yReal, name: '실질 구매력 (물가 반영 후)', type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines+markers',
        line: { color: '#34c759', width: 3 }, marker: { size: 5 },
        hovertemplate: '<b>%{x}</b><br>실질 구매력: %{y}억 원<br><extra></extra>'
      };

      let layout = {
        title: { text: '<b>연차별 포트폴리오 가치 추이 시뮬레이션</b>', font: { size: 15, family: '-apple-system, sans-serif' } },
        plot_bgcolor: '#f5f5f7', paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        xaxis: { tickfont: { size: 10 }, gridcolor: '#e8e8ed' },
        yaxis: { 
          title: '자산 평가액 (억 원)', 
          tickfont: { size: 11 }, 
          gridcolor: '#e8e8ed',
          ticksuffix: '억'
        },
        legend: { orientation: 'h', x: 0.5, xanchor: 'center', y: -0.18 },
        margin: { t: 50, b: 80, l: 65, r: 20 }
      };

      Plotly.newPlot('simulationChart', [traceNominal, traceReal], layout, {responsive: true, displayModeBar: false});
    }

    if (btnCalculate) {
      btnCalculate.addEventListener('click', runSimulation);
    }
    runSimulation();
  });
</script>

  </h4>
  
  <ul style="list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;">
    
    <li style="margin: 0; padding-left: 0;">
      <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 0.9rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px;">1. 연초 인출 및 실질 양도소득세 정산</strong>
      <span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #424245; line-height: 1.5;">매년 초 설정된 <strong>연간 인출률</strong>만큼 자산을 매도합니다. 이때 인출액 전체가 아닌 <strong>실질 양도차익 분</strong>만 추적 포집하여 기본공제액(250만 원) 차감 후 <strong>22%의 단일 세율</strong>로 세금을 정산합니다.</span>
    </li>
    
    <li style="margin: 0; padding-left: 0;">
      <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 0.9rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px;">2. 연말 자산 성장 및 계좌 수익률 복리 보정</strong>
      <span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #424245; line-height: 1.5;">인출 후 남은 잔여 자산은 1년 동안 <strong>예상(기대) 수익률</strong>만큼 성장합니다. 이때 발생한 자산 성장분은 전액 수익 계정으로 누적되므로, 계좌의 누적 수익률 구조는 매년 복리로 자동 업데이트됩니다.</span>
    </li>
    
    <li style="margin: 0; padding-left: 0;">
      <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 0.9rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px;">3. 누적 물가상승률(실질 구매력) 디스카운트 반영</strong>
      <span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #424245; line-height: 1.5;">연말에 정산된 명목 자산 잔액과 연초에 사용한 세후 현금흐름에 <strong>물가상승률</strong>을 누적 복리 디스카운트 팩터로 적용하여 화폐가치 하락이 반영된 <strong>실질 구매력 기준의 최종 지표</strong>를 사출합니다.</span>
    </li>
    
  </ul>

  <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1.2rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.6;">
    <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px;">📊 테이블 항목 범례</strong>
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;">
      <div><strong style="color: #86868b;">• 세후 (명목):</strong> <span style="color: #424245;">물가 상승률이 반영되지 않은 실제 획득 금액</span></div>
      <div><strong style="color: #007aff;">• 세후 (실질):</strong> <span style="color: #424245;">물가 상승률이 반영된 구매력</span></div>
      <div><strong style="color: #34c759;">• 실질 (잔액):</strong> <span style="color: #424245;">물가상승률을 반영한 현 시점 기준의 자산 가치</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```
